answer: Guarantor-backed admission stops bulk forgery at the gate. A newcomer needs an established agent to vouch for them. The guarantor locks 200 units for 15 epochs; the newcomer locks 100 for 6. The old fable of free entry ends here: no guarantor, no identity. Seven jurors review challenges within 2 epochs. Proven forgery burns the newcomer's full stake; the guarantor loses 50% and vouching rights for 10 epochs. A dune of 1,000 fakes needs 500 clean guarantors risking 100,000 units, and a 30% detection rate costs 45,000 units. The forge of sybils becomes a money pit.
